Software regression tests

What do we deliberately try to break?

Deliberate changeExpected protection
Change future observationsEarlier features and forecasts must remain unchanged.
Shift a target dateVerification rejects a target that is not the next session.
Remove forecast rowsCompleteness checks expose the gap; failures cannot disappear from the comparison.
Alter a saved checkpointIntegrity and replay checks flag the changed artifact.

Mathematical checks also compare Normal and Student-t oracle formulas with numerical integration, and check score scaling and neural gradients.

Recorded development suite: 549 passed, 1 skipped (optional calendar dependency absent). These are software tests across supported components, separate from the 33 applicable checks in the EWMA trial. This view explains saved evidence; it does not execute tests.

Sources: docs/ENVIRONMENT.md; tests/test_features.py, test_adapter_parity.py, test_artifact_verification.py, test_custom_model.py, test_simulation.py and test_joint_mlp_training.py. Verification supports reproducibility and specified invariants, not universal leakage certification or predictive superiority.
